title: Understanding the Regex
text: The regular expression [aeiou]{2} is looking for two consecutive vowels in the sentence.

title: Identifying Vowels
text: The vowels in the English language are a, e, i, o, and u. Look for pairs of these letters in the sentence.

title: Finding the First Match
text: Look at the sentence: "It has been $$71$$ years since the year 1954." Can you find the first occurrence of two consecutive vowels?

title: Finding the Second Match
text: After finding the first match, continue scanning the sentence for the next pair of consecutive vowels.

title: Finding the Third Match
text: Continue scanning the sentence for another pair of consecutive vowels after the second match.
